reproduction_target: Bacterial isolate genomics of two Irish Phytobacter strains plus a genus-wide comparative analysis: Illumina read QC (fastp), de novo assembly (Shovill), assembly QC (quast, checkM), ANI clustering (ANIclustermap) and dDDH/ANI species typing (GGDC/TYGS web service), annotation (Prokka) and pangenome/core-genome definition (Roary), core-gene Maximum-Likelihood phylogeny (RAxML) with SNP distances (snp-dists) and tree manipulation/visualization (ETE toolkit), plasmid reconstruction (MOB-recon / MOB-suite) and resistome profiling (Abricate + CARD 2023). Wet-lab work (isolate collection, MALDI-ToF identification, DNA extraction/library prep/NextSeq sequencing, MIC testing by MicroScan panel and UMIC colistin strips) is out of computational-reproduction scope.
granularity_note: Coarse one-step-per-named-tool from the 'Materials and methods' prose (sections 1.4.2-1.4.5). The genome set curation for the genus-wide analyses (NCBI GenBank accessed June 2025, MAGs / anomalous / suppressed assemblies excluded, n=32 plus the 2 Irish isolates = 34) is folded into the ANIclustermap step. No code repository, scripts, commands, workflow, notebook, or configuration file is provided anywhere in the paper, and there is no code-availability statement; the paper carries a 'Data reporting' section only. Wet-lab procedures counted in W, not verdicted.

steps.label: Raw-read quality control / filtering with fastp (Chen 2023); prose states '>25 Q score'; no version given
De novo genome assembly with Shovill v1.1.0, 'setting minimum contig length to 200'
Assembly quality/contiguity assessment with quast v5.3.0
Completeness/contamination assessment with checkM v1.2.3 (Parks et al. 2015); marker-set / lineage workflow not stated
Genus-wide ANI cluster map with ANIclustermap v1.3.0 over all canonical Phytobacter genomes in NCBI GenBank (accessed June 2025), excluding MAGs, anomalous assemblies and suppressed genomes (n=32)

Species typing by ANI and dDDH using the Genome-to-Genome Distance Calculator / TYGS web service (Meier-Kolthoff et al. 2022) against type strains DSM 17806T and ATCC 27989T; no version, no formula/threshold settings stated
Pangenome / core-genome definition with Roary v3.13.0 (Page et al. 2015); core-gene identity threshold and core-definition percentage not stated (only 'core genes n=523' reported)
Maximum-Likelihood core-genome phylogeny with RAxML v8.2.13 (Stamatakis 2014), GTRGAMMA model, 500 bootstraps, Kosakonia sacchari SP1 as outgroup
Clonality assessment of closely clustering genomes with snp-dists; no version, no parameters, and the upstream SNP-alignment source is not specified
Tree manipulation, analysis and visualization with the ETE toolkit (Huerta-Cepas et al. 2016, ETE 3); no version pinned in prose, no script provided

Plasmidic-contig detection and individual plasmid sequence reconstruction with MOB-recon (MOB-suite; Robertson & Nash 2018) across all 34 genomes; no version, no parameters, no MOB-suite database version
Resistome profiling with Abricate v1.0.0 against the CARD 2023 database (Alcock et al. 2023) on all chromosomal and predicted plasmid sequences; identity/coverage cutoffs not stated

headline.static_readiness: 0/13 (0%) - stage1 ceiling only, no R-star (R-star needs stage-2 code verification)
headline.inference_inclusive_upper_bound: All 13 computational steps cap at NI even under an inference-inclusive reading, because the Code axis is 0 for every step: the paper provides no repository, no scripts, no command lines, no workflow file and no code-availability statement, so nothing is re-executable as written. Version pinning is genuinely good for a majority subset (Shovill v1.1.0, quast v5.3.0, checkM v1.2.3, ANIclustermap v1.3.0, Prokka v1.14.5, Roary v3.13.0, RAxML v8.2.13, Abricate v1.0.0, CARD 2023) but fastp, GGDC/TYGS, snp-dists, ETE and MOB-recon are unversioned, and there is no environment closure of any kind. Even if the version axis were maximal, Code=0 holds every step at NI. There is no stage-2 artifact to read; this paper does not become R-star-eligible via a code check.
headline.coverage: 13 computational steps assessed from Materials and methods prose (sections 1.4.2-1.4.5); 5 wet-lab steps counted in W and out of computational-reproduction scope. Data reporting section present (GenBank/BioProject accessions); no code-availability section present.

gaps.missing: No code repository, scripts, command lines, workflow definition (Snakemake/Nextflow), notebooks, or configuration files anywhere in the paper, and no code-availability statement. The analysis is described only in prose, so no machine-executable artifact exists.
gaps.how_to_close: Deposit an analysis repository (GitHub + Zenodo DOI) containing the fastp/Shovill/quast/checkM commands, the genome-set download and exclusion script, the Prokka/Roary/RAxML/snp-dists/ETE commands, and the MOB-recon/Abricate invocations, so the pipeline can be re-executed end to end.

gaps.where: Software environment for all named tools
gaps.missing: No conda environment file, lockfile, container image or digest, or requirements manifest. Version pins are present for 8 tools plus one database year (Shovill v1.1.0, quast v5.3.0, checkM v1.2.3, ANIclustermap v1.3.0, Prokka v1.14.5, Roary v3.13.0, RAxML v8.2.13, Abricate v1.0.0, CARD 2023) but absent for fastp, GGDC/TYGS, snp-dists, ETE toolkit and MOB-recon (MOB-suite).
gaps.how_to_close: Ship a pinned environment (conda-lock / pixi.lock) or a container digest covering every tool, and record the missing five version numbers.

gaps.where: C3 quast, C4 checkM, C7 Prokka, C8 Roary, C10 snp-dists, C12 MOB-recon, C13 Abricate
gaps.missing: Parameters are not stated for these steps. Notably: checkM workflow/marker lineage; Prokka genus/kingdom and evidence settings; Roary core-gene identity threshold and core-definition percentage (only the resulting n=523 core genes is reported); Abricate --minid/--mincov cutoffs; MOB-recon settings; snp-dists options and which alignment it consumed.
gaps.how_to_close: State the full command line for each tool, or supply it in the analysis repository.

gaps.missing: The comparator genome set is defined by a query description ('all canonical Phytobacter genomes available in NCBI GenBank, accessed June 2025, excluding MAGs, anomalous assemblies and suppressed genomes, n=32') rather than by an explicit accession list in the Methods. A frozen, machine-readable accession list is not provided in the prose; supplementary tables report per-plasmid details but the input assembly accession manifest is not identified as such in the retrievable text.
gaps.how_to_close: Publish the exact assembly accession list (with assembly versions and download date) as a machine-readable file in the data or code deposit.

gaps.where: C4 checkM, C7 Prokka, C12 MOB-recon, C13 Abricate/CARD
gaps.missing: Reference database versions are unpinned or coarsely pinned: CARD is given only as '2023' (no CARD point release such as 3.2.x), and checkM marker-set, Prokka reference databases and the MOB-suite plasmid database version are not stated.
gaps.how_to_close: Record exact database release identifiers and retrieval dates, and archive the database snapshots used.

gaps.missing: No random seed is reported for the ML search or the 500-bootstrap replicates, so bootstrap support values are not bit-reproducible.
gaps.how_to_close: Report the RAxML -p and -x seeds and archive the resulting best-tree and bootstrap files.

gaps.where: Wet-lab: isolate collection from rectal swabs, MALDI-ToF identification (MALDI Biotyper), DNA extraction (Qiagen EZ1) + Illumina DNA Prep library prep + NextSeq1000 PE150 sequencing, MIC testing with MicroScan Gram-negative 63 Panel (EUCAST v15.0 2025 breakpoints), colistin MIC by UMIC strips
gaps.missing: Wet-lab generation and phenotypic validation steps are out of scope for computational reproduction (OOS); counted in W, not verdicted.
gaps.how_to_close: N/A for Tier-1 computational readiness; scope is the bioinformatic analysis.
